name: initialMode
label: Initial mode
description: Initial display mode to use for the first render before the component automatically detects which mode is recommended for the available space.

name: mode
label: Mode
description: Display mode for the components. When set to `auto`, the layout changes based on the available space. When set to `stacked`, components are stacked regardless of the available space.

name: sideBySideMinWidthPx
label: Minimum width required to display side-by-side
description: Minimum width in pixels required to display components in side-by-side mode.

name: useAvailableHeight
label: Use available height
description: Sets whether the components fill the entire available height of the panel.
